rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Output shape — trust Claude's defaults, don't pad.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Registry -3.md's '(Context / Decision / Consequences / Alternatives considered)' shape spec is teaching-moment-justified (the leap test at L157-159 requires exactly these four sections in the repo's convention), not padding; no other prompt appends a gratuitous trailing shape spec.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Strip strategy-doc vocabulary.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No strategy-doc term (veto-stakeholder, compounding substrate, authoring move, plan-mode approval inflation, gate spec, blast-radius constraint, judge, verifier, team kit, skills-as-capability) appears in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: What you build = 20-30 words.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L9: 'one recorded hardening decision, written as an ADR (Architecture Decision Record) in your repo's convention.' ~15 words, states the artifact plainly with no recipe/parentheticals padding — under the ceiling, and the rule's named harm (a bloated 55-word callout) is the opposite failure mode, not present here.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Describe failure modes, don't name them.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: No named failure-mode jargon coined in body (per-phase failure-mode names live correctly below the maintainer cut, e.g. 'P1 skill invocation ambiguity').

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Agency on right noun.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Every action verb in body is correctly attributed (the subagent/agent acts; you/the student judges and decides); no store-noun doing an agent's verb.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No em dashes on site.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: This is a curriculum source file, not ai-training site copy; the em-dash ban is already enforced and confirmed PASS under check_writing.md §1 for this surface.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No What research says callout boxes.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: No callout-box citation device present in body (duplicate of check_student_facing §11 for this surface).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't describe mood arc externally.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'here is our mood arc'-style meta-description anywhere in body; the mood is lived through the ADR/CISO stakes framing, not advertised.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Mood contract named.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Student leaves this exercise having made and recorded a real, defensible engineering call under named pressure (earned trust, deepening, per maintainer L114) — the ADR is then handed forward as now-real infrastructure the next exercise's test-strategy skill treats as security-tested (L89), which sets up rather than steals the next beat's teaching moment. Mood-floor check: no mechanical/setup beat scored below a teaching-beat bar; Phase transitions (Time/Window lines) are correctly mood-exempt plumbing.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Lead with discipline, not failure mode.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Title (L1) 'Pick one threat, record the decision' leads with the discipline (pick + record), not a failure word (no 'threat blindness'/'STRIDE failures' framing).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Strategy-fidelity check.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Internal-consistency check only (bosser-strategy content-strategy doc not loaded for this pass, out of scope for a single-file writing-class confirmation): the M4 forward-reference at L79 names only that M4 gives an explicit read-list, without revealing M4's mechanism, and the Artefact Contracts table's downstream consumers (M3 Ex3, M4 Phase 2) match what body prose itself claims (L89). No visible front-run of a downstream teaching moment.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Rough-cut drafts for articles.
Verbatim-frame-cite in reference artefact.
Cap practitioner attribution at one student-side mention per module.
A claim binds to every body that states it, not just the one holding the stamp.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Ran `grep -rl "stride-microsoft"` and `grep -rl "STRIDE's value is rejection"` across curriculum/ — both resolve only to this file (plus generated body-view/instance derivatives, not separate source files). Single-file claim, nothing to keep in step.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A rule set reconstructed at session start goes stale inside the session — re-derive it per target, not per sweep.
One doc per scarce-attention audience; delta-only.
Trainer-facing text is self-contained.
Memory vs context — use deliberately.
Q1/Q2/Q3 retro interview is banned at every module.
Simulation personas never alone.
Inline links use target's title, never filename.
Operational reminders live at moment of use, not only where introduced.
Four sharing strategies (Agents 101 M7 canonical) — use verbatim.
Agents 101 M2+ Debrief — canonical shape.
Multi-sample methods need structural enforcement.
Runtime-fork prompts: paired divs, shared chip.
Runtime-mechanical scaffolding asymmetry — MORE in less-fluent fork, not less.
Append-vs-integrate — name integration mode on regeneration with new context source.
Citation discipline — extend cite-or-flag scope + quote supporting sentence.
Niceness tax — name the edge or pin the line on regeneration.
Question-dump default — `in turn` too soft; two legal shapes.
Overwrite anxiety — name overwrite default on regeneration.
Self-critique register, not defense, when Claude interrogates own work.
Minimal hand-off + Claude self-augments for send-off prompts.
Prompt-body edits require maintainer approval — registry files AND inline blocks.
Artifact destinations are explicit subpaths, never naked filenames (Agents 101-specific).
Maintainer-approval edits — ONE-AT-A-TIME, PRIORITY-ORDERED, FOUR-FIELD cards.
Live-test corrections preserve operator workflow.
Module names in prompt prose are fine — they ground the session.
Git-output greps asserting exact-N need multi-result fallback.
Repeated Q&A → premature re-edits. Separate iteration from persistence.
Orient saved rule by where it FIRES, not surface activity producing it.
Declare `permission-mode:` when paste requires specific Claude Code mode.
rules_evaluated.evidence: expand-md.js output shows no mode chip on any of the four prompts; none of the four depends on a non-default permission mode.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Headless-runner discipline — tail every prompt with no-AUQ guard.
Prompt paths match Builder scope.
"Add X and regenerate" is a trap.
Vary closings deliberately.
CTO-repeatable test.
No stylized phrase-pairs.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No Rory two-beat 'X. And Y.' construction present in body regardless.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Earn every term.
No M-number cross-references.
Ownership claims scope to customer-built artifacts.
Numbers carry their denominator + axis.
Epistemic mood ≠ punitive mood.
Strategic themes recur in Key Concepts.
Key Concepts shape — theme breadcrumbs, not standalone section.
What You'll Learn shape — capability register, not syllabus.
